svg.aria-label: Player in the article: Episodes and videos play under the title, in one compact player. Speed and sleep timer: 0.8× to 3×, kept for next time; a timer that fades out. Carries on: Picks up where you stopped; marked read once mostly played. Notification: Speed, back 30, progress, forward 30 and stop; resume after a restart. Videos: In their own shape, with picture-in-picture and full screen. Now playing: A pill above the bottom bar; tap it for the full controls. YouTube: Videos inside articles open in the YouTube app. Feed pictures: A podcast's cover as its feed's icon, or the website's icon.
